title: Capability Registry Scope Contract
description: Declares a registry scope's identity, IP owner, visibility, and promotion policy. Registry-native — deliberately NOT a mesh-contract (that schema's ip_owner enum cannot express non-mesh owners).

scope.description: Scope directory this contract governs — must equal the directory name.

parent_scope.description: Scope this scope promotes into (universe scopes promote into platform only, after sanitisation).

ip_owner.description: Legal IP owner of this scope's content (free string — mesh-contract enum does not apply here).

visibility.description: all-universes = consumable by any repo; <universe> = only repos declaring that universe; local-only = never published.

promotion_policy.description: Mesh-contract-compatible promotion stub — governs universe->platform promotion automation.
